junk_imagery.evidence: All imagery is the channel's own vector art (tank, line, bubbles, scale with butterflies, butterfly wings in seg4:mid). There is no stock or AI photo.

decorative_mascot.evidence: Data stands holding a pole inside an already-drained tank (hook@0.3 to seg0:end), holds his head beside a line (seg1:mid), sits on top of the 17% bubble (seg2:mid) and clings to the left edge (seg3:mid). Only seg4 gives him an action (sawing a wing), and that action illustrates a wrong comparison.

bare_number_card.evidence: Every beat has a visual form (tank, line, bubbles, scale, wing cut). None is just a number on a blob.

dead_air.evidence: The tank frame is almost unchanged from hook@0.3 to seg0:end (about 3s), then dims through seg1:start. Measured held_s is 5.17 and max_dup_run is 41 at 3.67s, so the opening is effectively frozen for about 5s.

empty_void.evidence: The frames use navy gradients with no large black dead area (dark_fraction 0.0). The tank in the hook does leave the top 60% of the frame empty, but it is not a void.

unreadable.evidence: In seg4:mid, payoff@-0.4 and seg4:end, Data's legs and saw sit on top of '−15 pts'. In seg3:start to seg3:end, Data's body covers the left edge of '95%' and 'Western route' at the frame edge. In hook@0.3, the four labels '2017 2.5 / 2020 2.1 / 2024 0.9 / 2013 0.7' are crammed into about 50px.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg4:mid shows 'Eastern route (since 1990s) 80% / was 95%' with '−15 pts'. That presents the western route's 95% as an earlier value of the eastern route, which is a fabricated change. Data's feet and saw also cover the '−15 pts' text, and he stands on a floating ladder next to a dashed box that has no meaning.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The closing compare template treated the two categories (western, eastern) as before/after values of one series and computed a delta between unrelated measures. The mascot anchor was placed over the delta label.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show the closing as the two routes side by side, or as one wing for the subject: a monarch wing shrinking to its remaining share (5% west, 20% east), with Data cutting it away himself. Remove the 'was 95%' / '−15 pts' delta and keep every label clear of the mascot.

depictions.note: A generic tank that is already drained when the video starts, so the 18→0.9 loss never visibly happens. Labels are crammed and out of order.
A plain line chart of forest hectares with a circled 0.9.
Bubbles sized by 17% and 94% show the growth, but the form is generic and has no soy or herbicide in it.
A stock seesaw with butterfly icons. It tilts toward 80% even though 95% is the larger loss, and comparing two losses on a balance asserts nothing.
Sawing a monarch wing is made of the subject, but the number it carries is a fabricated delta between the two routes.

grades.one_line: The opening tank is frozen and already empty, three middle beats are stock charts and machines, and the closer presents a fabricated '95%→80%, −15 pts' change between two different routes, with text covered by the mascot.
problems: The hook shows a static, already-drained tank for about 5s, so nothing happens in the first seconds.
The hook line 'Your garden vanished 94% of monarch milkweed' is garbled and mixes the herbicide stat with milkweed.
Tank labels are crammed into about 50px and ordered 2017/2020/2024/2013.
seg1 is a plain line chart and seg2 is plain bubbles, with Data posing beside or on top of them.
On the seg3 scale the arm drops toward 80% even though 95% is the larger loss, and Data covers the Western label at the frame edge.
seg4 claims the eastern route 'was 95%' and dropped '−15 pts', which is false (it is the western figure), and Data's legs cover the '−15 pts' text.
fixes: Open on the forest actually shrinking: 18.2 ha of fir canopy draining to 0.9 while Data cuts or carries it away, so the motion is visible from frame 1.
Rewrite the hook to a coherent claim, for example 'Monarchs lost 95% of their winter forest'.
Make seg2 bespoke: a field of soybean rows turning herbicide-resistant from 17% to 94%, with Data spraying it.
Replace the balance with two migrating swarms thinning to 5% and 20% of their size.
Remove the cross-route delta in seg4 and keep labels clear of the mascot's anchor.
